module_summary: RISC-V Sv32 MMU: single-entry instruction and data TLBs translate fetch and LSU addresses with permission fault checks; a 2-level page-table-walk FSM refills them via PTE reads muxed onto the LSU memory port.

anchors.name: genblk1.state_q
anchors.why: Page table walker FSM: idle, first level, second level, TLB update

anchors.name: genblk1.itlb_entry_q
anchors.why: Instruction TLB entry: physical page and permission flags

anchors.name: genblk1.itlb_va_addr_q
anchors.why: Instruction TLB virtual page tag

anchors.name: genblk1.itlb_valid_q
anchors.why: Instruction TLB valid bit, cleared on flush

anchors.name: genblk1.dtlb_entry_q
anchors.why: Data TLB entry: physical page and permission flags

anchors.name: genblk1.dtlb_va_addr_q
anchors.why: Data TLB virtual page tag

anchors.name: genblk1.dtlb_valid_q
anchors.why: Data TLB valid bit, cleared on flush

anchors.name: genblk1.itlb_hit_w
anchors.why: ITLB hit gates translated fetch request and accept

anchors.name: genblk1.dtlb_hit_w
anchors.why: DTLB hit gates translated LSU read/write and accept

anchors.name: genblk1.itlb_miss_w
anchors.why: Instruction TLB miss starts page table walk

anchors.name: genblk1.dtlb_miss_w
anchors.why: Data TLB miss starts walk, prioritized over instruction miss

anchors.name: genblk1.pte_addr_q
anchors.why: PTE fetch address for current walk level

anchors.name: genblk1.pte_entry_q
anchors.why: Resolved translation entry written into ITLB or DTLB

anchors.name: genblk1.virt_addr_q
anchors.why: Virtual address being walked; becomes TLB tag

anchors.name: genblk1.dtlb_req_q
anchors.why: Walk is for data side; selects which TLB is updated

anchors.name: genblk1.src_mmu_w
anchors.why: Selects MMU PTE request or CPU LSU request onto memory port

anchors.name: genblk1.read_hold_q
anchors.why: Holds request source while memory port not accepting

anchors.name: genblk1.mem_req_q
anchors.why: PTE read request pending on memory port

anchors.name: genblk1.resp_valid_w
anchors.why: MMU-tagged PTE response valid advancing walk

anchors.name: genblk1.pc_fault_r
anchors.why: Instruction fetch permission fault from ITLB flags

anchors.name: genblk1.load_fault_r
anchors.why: Load permission fault from DTLB flags blocks memory read

anchors.name: genblk1.store_fault_r
anchors.why: Store permission fault from DTLB flags blocks memory write

anchors.name: genblk1.vm_d_enable_w
anchors.why: Data translation enabled by satp mode and privilege

anchors.name: genblk1.vm_i_enable_w
anchors.why: Instruction translation enabled for non-machine privilege

anchors.name: genblk1.lsu_in_addr_q
anchors.why: Holds LSU address while request stalls for walk

anchors.name: genblk1.load_q
anchors.why: Pending unaccepted load request

anchors.name: satp_i
anchors.why: satp CSR: translation mode and page table base

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: TLB flush command invalidating both TLBs

anchors.name: fetch_in_pc_i
anchors.why: Virtual fetch PC to translate

anchors.name: fetch_in_rd_i
anchors.why: Fetch request from frontend

anchors.name: fetch_in_accept_o
anchors.why: Fetch accept on hit plus downstream accept or fault

anchors.name: fetch_out_pc_o
anchors.why: Translated physical fetch address to icache

anchors.name: fetch_out_rd_o
anchors.why: Fetch request forwarded on ITLB hit without fault

anchors.name: lsu_in_addr_i
anchors.why: Virtual LSU address to translate

anchors.name: lsu_in_accept_o
anchors.why: LSU accept on DTLB hit and memory accept or fault

anchors.name: lsu_out_addr_o
anchors.why: Memory port address: translated LSU address or PTE address

anchors.name: lsu_out_rd_o
anchors.why: Memory read request from MMU walk or CPU load

anchors.name: lsu_out_accept_i
anchors.why: Memory port accept steering MMU/CPU accept

anchors.name: lsu_out_data_rd_i
anchors.why: Memory read data; carries PTEs during walks

anchors.name: fetch_in_fault_o
anchors.why: Instruction page fault indication

anchors.name: lsu_in_load_fault_o
anchors.why: Load page fault indication

anchors.name: lsu_in_store_fault_o
anchors.why: Store page fault indication

groups.name: Page table walker
groups.description: Two-level Sv32 walk FSM fetching PTEs and building translation entries

groups.name: Instruction TLB
groups.description: Single-entry ITLB translating fetch PC with execute permission checks

groups.name: Data TLB
groups.description: Single-entry DTLB translating LSU addresses with load/store permission checks

groups.name: Memory port mux
groups.description: Muxes PTE fetches and CPU LSU requests onto shared memory port
